{"metadata":{"description":"Windows 专用 DSH 插件，专为偏好受控权限的用户打造：侧边栏操作面板可手动扫描 Low 完整性标签、S-1-4-* 沙箱授权 ACE 及同目录 Everyone 拒绝项，一键修复并复扫校验，每个工作区保留可替换回滚记录。EN: Windows-only DSH plugin for permission-conscious users: sidebar panel manually scans Low integrity labels, S-1-4 sandbox ACEs and related Everyone deny ACEs, wit","id":"gh:1440944594","install_available":true,"language":"PowerShell","name":"dsh-file-integrity-check","slug":"Dofang-C/dsh-file-integrity-check","topics":["acl","dsh-plugin","integrity-level","security","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Windows 专用 DSH 插件，专为偏好受控权限的用户打造：侧边栏操作面板可手动扫描 Low 完整性标签、S-1-4-* 沙箱授权 ACE 及同目录 Everyone 拒绝项，一键修复并复扫校验，"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"每个工作区保留可替换回滚记录。EN: Windows-only DSH plugin for permission-conscious users: sidebar panel manually sc"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ans Low integrity labels, S-1-4 sandbox ACEs and related Everyone deny ACEs, wit"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-file-integrity-check"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH runs restricted Windows workspaces under a Low mandatory integrity label so its restricted token"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" can write there. The label and the sandbox's explicit `S-1-4-*` ACEs live in the directory's on-dis"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"k ACL, so they can outlast the session, the workspace removal, and even a DSH update. On directories"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" that remain marked, installers, IDEs, backup tools, and other programs may later fail permission ch"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ecks or behave unexpectedly."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This plugin gives those directories a controlled cleanup path. It reads the **live DSH workspace lis"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"t** (not a disk crawl), scans each workspace without changing anything, reports the exact directorie"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"s and finding types, repairs only the sandbox residue after confirmation, and verifies the result. E"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ach workspace keeps one replaceable ACL rollback record, so the last repair can be undone or its rec"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ord permanently deleted."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The three findings it understands:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Low integrity label** on a directory (SACL mandatory label, `S-1-16-4096`)
- **Explicit `S-1-4-*"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"` sandbox allow ACEs** (non-inherited)
- **`Everyone:(DENY)(DC)`** only when it appears on the same "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"directory as one of
the two findings above"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"It never touches normal workspace grants such as `X2\<user>:(F)`. A standalone
`Everyone` deny is no"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t a finding and is left alone."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The plugin has a white workspace-mapped page in the DSH sidebar, plus a
standalone PowerShell engine"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" that can be used without DSH."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Scan** any DSH workspace, or all workspaces at once.
- **Fix** with an explicit confirmation; a "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"read-only dry run is the default.
- **Verify** after fixing and show `Low` / `S-1-4` counts.
- **One"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" rollback record per workspace.** The newest successful fix replaces the
previous record. A record c"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"an be kept indefinitely or permanently deleted;
deleting it removes every file and empty folder it o"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"wns.
- **Workspace mapping** comes from DSH's workspace registry. If a workspace is
deleted in DSH, "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"its card disappears from the plugin page.
- **No third-party dependencies.** The engine is Windows P"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"owerShell 5.1 /
PowerShell 7 plus inline C# P/Invoke and `icacls`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"#### From dsh-market"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Once the catalog entry is merged, search for **文件完整性检查** / **File Integrity
Check** in dsh-market an"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" entry is merged, search for **文件完整性检查** / **File Integrity
Check** in dsh-market and click Install."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"#### From source"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Clone the repository, then add the directory as a local DSH bundle through the
Plugin Manager (`inst"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"all_bundle`). For example, with the DSH agent tool:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"After installation, refresh the DSH web GUI. The sidebar shows a shield icon
named **文件完整性检查**. If t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"he Host half changed, fully quit and reopen DSH,
not just the page."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Use"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. Open **文件完整性检查** from the sidebar.
2. Each DSH workspace gets one card, read from the live worksp"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ace list.
3. **扫描 (Scan)** is read-only.
4. **修复 (Fix)** asks for confirmation, saves the current AC"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"L, then changes it.
5. **校验 (Verify)** rescans and reports the remaining counts.
6. **扫描全部工作区 (Scan "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"all)** scans every current workspace in one request."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- The mandatory label is read via `GetNamedSecurityInfoW` with
`LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION` and the "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"`SYSTEM_MANDATORY_LABEL_ACE` (type
`0x11`). The last SID sub-authority is `0x1000` for Low and `0x20"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"00` for
Medium.
- The DACL is read through the same API. Only **non-inherited** ACEs whose SID
autho"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"rity is 4 (`S-1-4-*`) are removed. `Everyone` deny ACEs are removed only
when the same directory is "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"already a Low/S-1-4 finding.
- The root label is restored with an inheritable Medium label
(`icacls "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"/setintegritylevel "(OI)(CI)M"`). If a child has an explicit Low
label, it is fixed individually.
- "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"The original DACL is stored as SDDL plus an `icacls /save` `.acl` file. The
rollback record contains"},{"id":"p24s8","text":" `manifest.json`, `root.acl`, and `root.sddl`.
- Reparse points and junctions are never followed. Lo"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ng paths use the `\\?\`
prefix. Heavy directories such as `node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, `.venv`,
a"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"nd `AppData\Local\Temp` are skipped."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- DSH 0.2.1 or newer (desktop or web)
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerSh"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"dows 10 or Windows 11
- DSH 0.2.1 or newer (desktop or web)
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### 功能"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **扫描**单个 DSH 工作区，或一键扫描全部工作区。
- **修复**前必须确认；未加 `-Apply` 时只读，不修改任何 ACL。
- **校验**修复结果，显示剩余的 `Low` 与 `"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"S-1-4` 数量。
- **每个工作区只保留一条回滚记录**；下一次成功修复会替换旧记录。记录可以一直保留，也可以永久删除，删除后不留下任何文件或空文件夹。
- **工作区映射**直接读取 DSH "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"的实时工作区列表；在 DSH 里删除工作区后，插件页面对应卡片会自动消失。
- **无第三方依赖**：Windows PowerShell 5.1 / PowerShell 7 + 内联 C# P/I"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"除工作区后，插件页面对应卡片会自动消失。
- **无第三方依赖**：Windows PowerShell 5.1 / PowerShell 7 + 内联 C# P/Invoke + `icacls`。"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 安全边界"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- 只删除**非继承**的 `S-1-4-*` 授权 ACE。
- 只在同一目录已命中 Low 或 S-1-4 时，才删除 `Everyone:(DENY)(DC)`。
- 只把 Low 恢复为 Me"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"dium。

- 不要求管理员权限；受保护的系统目录如果无权限，只报告并跳过，不强行"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"m。
